projects.name: Minibus app
projects.focus: Owner dashboard and driver app come first: owners pay, and drivers' GPS feeds everything else. Then the passenger app. Mobile money fares. Must work on low-cost Android phones.

projects.name: Local-language AI
projects.focus: Voice-first assistant that hears and speaks African languages. The web app in web/ is built; next is the core API (apiUrl), our own speech models (sttUrl, ttsUrl), and new channels such as WhatsApp, SMS, USSD and voice calls, each as a feature on top of the same core. Farmers and everyday users.

projects.name: Creator social app
projects.focus: Short video and posts that pay African creators through tips, gifts, shopping and brand deals, paid out by mobile money. Keep video costs low. Moderation from day one.

projects.name: ADT agent
projects.focus: The agent itself: better proposals, a daily network status report, a status page on the ADT website, and payout tracking.
